caption_summary: One short descriptive sentence about the link between age-appropriate activity and falling asleep; no CTA, no hashtags
what_makes_it_work: The cover names the problem and a surprising cause (the day, not the night), then three separate keyword pills each offer a different free item. It reached 533 comments on only 73 likes, so keyword replies seem to drive the count.
lumebook_takeaway: A cover that promises an unexpected cause plus several small keyword offers along the way gives readers many reasons to comment.
